note: Event cards typed by Orbis from the cited Wikipedia articles. Dates are stored in the Gregorian calendar; cards marked Julian also show the date as their sources give it.

items.title: France annexes the left bank
items.text: In the Treaty of Lunéville the Emperor accepted France's border on the Rhine. The princes who lost land on the left bank were to be compensated inside the Empire.

items.title: The Imperial Recess
items.text: A deputation of the Imperial Diet at Regensburg dissolved almost all church states and all but six of the 51 free imperial cities. In all, 112 imperial estates disappeared; their land went to 72 rulers, mostly Prussia, Bavaria, Württemberg and Baden.

items.title: Battle of Austerlitz
items.text: Napoleon defeated the Austrian and Russian armies in Moravia. In the Peace of Pressburg Austria gave up Tyrol and its lands in Swabia.

items.title: Confederation of the Rhine
items.text: Sixteen German states signed a treaty in Paris placing themselves under Napoleon's protection; on 1 August they declared that they had left the Empire.

items.title: The Empire ends
items.text: In Vienna, Francis II laid down the imperial crown and declared the Empire dissolved. He kept the title Emperor of Austria, which he had taken in 1804.
items.source: Wikipedia, 'Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire'

items.title: Kingdom of Westphalia
items.text: After defeating Prussia, Napoleon created a Kingdom of Westphalia for his brother Jérôme, with Kassel as its capital, from Hesse-Kassel, Brunswick and Prussian lands west of the Elbe.
